mode: Audit plus durable JSON receipt only; no structure run, staging, commit, work-item mutation, or product/tooling source edits.

scope.question: Closed-denominator reach audit for active structural gates whose law may apply to @orb/client, @orb/ui, @orb/contracts, @orb/kit, and @orb/inference, with showcase/default-content and resource-only reach adjudicated explicitly.
scope.note: Counts are verifier source candidates, so declaration files and paths absent from routed programs are excluded. The raw authored package counts are client 1341, UI 406, contracts 133, kit 66, inference 114, showcase 33, default-content 30.

commands: node --input-type=module -e \u0027import {loadPolicyCorpus} from \"./tooling/src/verify/lib/policy-loader.ts\"; import {planPolicyArgv} from \"./tooling/src/verify/lib/policy-plan.ts\"; const root=process.cwd(); const corpus=await loadPolicyCorpus(root); console.log(JSON.stringify(planPolicyArgv(root,[\"--list\",\"--json\"],corpus)))\u0027

node --input-type=module -e \u0027import {loadPolicyCorpus} from \"./tooling/src/verify/lib/policy-loader.ts\"; import {resolvePolicyScope} from \"./tooling/src/verify/lib/policy-scope.ts\"; import {policySourceCandidates} from \"./tooling/src/verify/lib/policy-source-candidate.ts\"; import {resolvePopulation} from \"./tooling/src/verify/lib/population-resolver.ts\"; const root=process.cwd(), corpus=await loadPolicyCorpus(root), scope=resolvePolicyScope(root,{kind:\"whole\"}), candidates=policySourceCandidates(scope.programs.flatMap(p=>p.files)); for (const gate of corpus.gates) console.log(gate.id, resolvePopulation(gate.population,candidates).paths.length)\u0027
